# Third-party libraries

- JSZip 3.10.1: https://github.com/Stuk/jszip — distributed under its MIT option; includes pako (MIT). See LICENSE-JSZip-MIT.txt and the original header in jszip.min.js.
- PDF.js: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js — Copyright 2024 Mozilla Foundation, Apache License 2.0. See LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt and the original headers in pdf.min.mjs and pdf.worker.min.mjs.

The vendor files are unchanged upstream minified distributions. Alif+ conversion code is in ../converter.js and ../documents.js.
